description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact KB path `Obsidian/Docs/OpenClaw/` with `docs/` and `tips/` subdirectories. (2) Create at least 2 tip articles under `tips/` strictly following the 5-section Markdown template (## 简介, ## 使用场景, ## 详细步骤, ## 示例 with a code block, ## 注意事项). (3) Create `daily-tips.json` at `Obsidian/Docs/OpenClaw/` (NOT the wrong decoy location at `Obsidian/daily-tips.json`) with a valid JSON structure. (4) Create `crontab.txt` with the exact non-obvious cron times: `21 3 * * * scripts/sync-docs.sh` (03:21), `5 21 * * * scripts/pick-daily-tip.sh` (21:05), and `21 7 * * * scripts/send-daily-tip.sh` (07:21) — agents relying on training will guess round hours like 07:00/21:00. (5) Create `tips-log.md` and `latest-version.txt` at the KB root. (6) Place at least one markdown file in `docs/`. The proprietary traps are: the exact path `Obsidian/Docs/OpenClaw/`, the non-round cron minutes (21 and 05), the decoy `daily-tips.json` at the wrong location, and the strict 5-section tip template.
